newsitem.title: USA: Calgene establishes new credit line.
newsitem.headline: Calgene establishes new credit line.

text.p: Calgene Inc, which Wednesday reported a loss of $0.72 per share in its second quarter, also said it has established a multi-year working capital line of credit with Bank of America.
The line of credit is $20 million in 1997, increasing to $30 million in 1998 and $40 million until its expiration in December 1999.
The company said its weak second quarter results were due mainly to low tomato prices.

"In response to these market conditions, we have consolidated and streamlined operations, and significantly reduced expenses, President Lloyd Kunimoto said in a statement. "As a result of these measures, we believe our cost structure is now very competitive in today's tomato market."
